title: Falling With the Least Harm: How Long Before the Ground, Whether There Is Time to Recover, and Going Soft to Spread the Blow

artifact.note: the end of balance: the time a tilting body (an inverted pendulum with a tilt and a tilt rate) has before it reaches the ground, by stepping the pendulum's equation; a decision, from the tilt, the rate and that time, between nothing, trying to recover (a step, 35-07, needs time to be taken), going soft to protect the robot (when there is no time left), and having fallen; the force of the landing as the energy to be taken up over the distance the legs and body give, and so what going soft is worth; and the checks that a robot that has fallen is not made to get up on a hot or broken leg
